The best place to check is the "use by" date printed on the packaging, which tells you how long it's safe to keep in the fridge. The label will also say whether the chicken is suitable for freezing, and many labels include a "freeze on day of purchase" note if it applies.

As a general rule, always keep raw chicken in the coldest part of your fridge, on the bottom shelf, in a sealed container so it can't drip onto other food.

If anything about the chicken looks or smells off when it arrives, please send us a photo and your order number. We treat food safety concerns as urgent and will have a person look at it the same day.
